descriptionByLocale.en:
We seek a responsible personality in the function as Care management 60 - 80% / Member of the management Their activities Responsibility for the provision of our core services Implementation of the occupational nursing mission statement Further development and implementation of operational nursing and specialist concepts Responsibility for ensuring care processes and quality of care Co-responsibility for an internal control and quality management system (IKS / QMS) What sets you apart Completion of HF/FH in the Department of Care Further education in leadership / management Several years of experience in a senior position in care, Spitex experience beneficial High level of technical and social competence Strong organisational competence and high degree of independence Holistic, conceptual and analytical thinking What you can look forward to An exciting workplace with versatile
• Tasks and high personal responsibility Short decision-making paths with great right of co-determination A dynamic working environment that you can help shape Interdisciplinary cooperation at eye level Do you feel addressed and would like to complement our team? Then we look forward to your application to jobs@spitexoberaargau-ag.ch. If you have any questions about the job advertisement, Verena Zimmermann, Managing Director, is happy to provide information on 062 531 68 20.
